legend: Vasya has recently developed a new algorithm to optimize the reception of customer flow and he considered the following problem.

Let the queue to the cashier contain n people, at that each of them is characterized by a positive integer ai — that is the time needed to work with this customer. What is special about this very cashier is that it can serve two customers simultaneously. However, if two customers need ai and aj of time to be served, the time needed to work with both of them customers is equal to max(ai, aj). Please note that working with customers is an uninterruptable process, and therefore, if two people simultaneously come to the cashier, it means that they begin to be served simultaneously, and will both finish simultaneously (it is possible that one of them will have to wait).

Vasya used in his algorithm an ingenious heuristic — as long as the queue has more than one person waiting, then some two people of the first three standing in front of the queue are sent simultaneously. If the queue has only one customer number i, then he goes to the cashier, and is served within ai of time. Note that the total number of phases of serving a customer will always be equal to ⌈n / 2⌉.

Vasya thinks that this method will help to cope with the queues we all hate. That's why he asked you to work out a program that will determine the minimum time during which the whole queue will be served using this algorithm.
input: The first line of the input file contains a single number n (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000), which is the number of people in the sequence. The second line contains space-separated integers a1, a2, ..., an (1 ≤ ai ≤ 106). The people are numbered starting from the cashier to the end of the queue.
output: Print on the first line a single number — the minimum time needed to process all n people. Then on ⌈n / 2⌉ lines print the order in which customers will be served. Each line (probably, except for the last one) must contain two numbers separated by a space — the numbers of customers who will be served at the current stage of processing. If n is odd, then the last line must contain a single number — the number of the last served customer in the queue. The customers are numbered starting from 1.

legend.ai: Vasya 最近开发了一种用于优化客户流接待的新算法，于是他考虑了如下问题。

收银员前排着一支包含 n 个人的队伍，其中每个人都由一个正整数 ai 表示，即与该顾客办理业务所需的时间。这位收银员的特别之处在于，他可以同时为两位顾客服务。然而，如果两位顾客分别需要 ai 和 aj 的服务时间，那么同时为这两位顾客办理业务所需的时间等于 max(ai, aj)。请注意，为顾客办理业务的过程是不可中断的。因此，如果两个人同时来到收银员处，就意味着他们会同时开始接受服务，并且同时结束服务（其中一人可能需要等待）。
Vasya 在他的算法中使用了一种巧妙的启发式方法——只要队列中等待的人数超过一个，就从队首的前三个人中选出某两个人同时接受服务。如果队列中只剩下一位编号为 i 的顾客，那么他会前往收银员处，并在 ai 的时间内接受服务。注意，服务顾客的总阶段数始终等于 ⌈n / 2⌉。
Vasya 认为这种方法能够帮助解决我们都深恶痛绝的排队问题。因此，他请你编写一个程序，使用该算法求出服务完整支队列所需的最短时间。

input.ai: 输入文件的第一行包含一个整数 n（1 ≤ n ≤ 1000），表示队列中的人数。第二行包含 n 个以空格分隔的整数 a1、a2、...、an（1 ≤ ai ≤ 106）。顾客按照从靠近收银员到队尾的顺序编号。

output.ai: 第一行输出一个整数，表示处理完全部 n 位顾客所需的最短时间。接下来输出 ⌈n / 2⌉ 行，表示顾客接受服务的顺序。每一行（最后一行可能除外）必须包含两个以空格分隔的整数，表示当前处理阶段接受服务的两位顾客的编号。如果 n 为奇数，则最后一行必须包含一个整数，表示队列中最后一位接受服务的顾客编号。顾客的编号从 1 开始。
